title: crm/crm.config.yml — rasa.module.crm (records-family/1)
description: What a project declares to rasa.module.crm. Every key except `schema` is optional and a project with no config file is valid, except that `crm lead advance` into the qualified stage refuses until `qualification` is declared. Every vocabulary list follows declare-to-constrain (absent or [] = free; non-empty = closed) — except `stages` and `account_statuses`, which have defaults and are always closed.

stages.description: The ordered sales stages; each is a directory under crm/leads/. NOT free when absent: the default is [new, contacted, qualified, proposal, won, lost]. Must contain won_stage, lost_stage and qualified_stage; the first stage is where new leads are filed.

won_stage.description: The terminal stage `crm lead win` moves to. Default: won.

lost_stage.description: The terminal stage `crm lead lose` moves to. Default: lost.

qualified_stage.description: The stage at which a lead counts as qualified; entering it (or any later open stage) requires the qualification criteria. Default: qualified.

qualification.description: THE HARD-STOP: the criteria a lead must meet to be qualified, each asserted with `crm lead advance … --met`. `crm lead advance` into the qualified stage refuses until this is declared. What each criterion means is prose in .claude/crm-gate.md.

sources.description: Where leads come from. Declare to constrain.

account_statuses.description: The account statuses. NOT free when absent: the default is [prospect, active, churned]; the first is the status a new account starts in.

active_status.description: The status that means 'a current customer'; `crm lead win` moves the account there. Default: active.

contact_roles.description: The roles a person plays at an account (the `role` in a card's accounts). Declare to constrain.

groups.description: Address-book groups (vCard CATEGORIES). Declare to constrain.

labels.description: The labels an email, phone, address or URL may carry (work, home, mobile, …). Declare to constrain.

default_currency.description: The currency `crm lead new --value` uses when --currency is not given.
